messages:
Bryan Chen: fyi acmeprod reporting repeated 429s + huge tail latency since 09:10 US-PST. They're on a Dedicated pool (dp-usw2a-23). Requests are queued while scale tries to add nodes but pods never become ready (ImagePullBackOff / CrashLoop).
Maya Patel: thanks — any recent changes on their side? auth rotations, new images, or infra deploys?
Bryan Chen: customer rotated their container registry token at ~09:04 (they call it 'registry-key-rot-2026-03'). They also did a small release 09:06. We started seeing failed pulls concurrently.
Kevin Zhao: grabbing autoscaler logs and k8s events now. short summary: autoscaler created new pods, kube created nodes, but pods are stuck `ImagePullBackOff` with 401 from registry and some `429 Too Many Requests` from our image pull proxy. Looks like registry auth + proxy rate limiting.
Bryan Chen: snippet from pod event log:```
Events:
  Normal Pulling  Pulling image "acmeprod/service:2026-03-15"
  Warning Failed   Failed to pull image "acmeprod/service:2026-03-15": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch token: 401 Unauthorized
  Warning BackOff  Back-off pulling image "acmeprod/service:2026-03-15"
```
AutoscaleBot: [autoscaler/dp-usw2a-23] created 8 nodes between 09:11:05 and 09:18:30, pods pending: 12, ready pods: 2. Queue length peaked at 312 reqs.
Maya Patel: that aligns. If pods can't pull images, scaling looks like it's happening but effective capacity remains low -> customer sees throttling. Two possible vectors: 1) registry token rotation left old token cached in imagePullSecret on infra nodes (should be fine) OR 2) our image-pull proxy hit rate limits and returned 429 for retries, causing backoff in kube and slow readiness.
Kevin Zhao: checked our registry proxy metrics: we saw a burst of token requests from dp-usw2a-23 between 09:07-09:12 and 50% 429s due to short-lived token churn. Also saw node creation throttles around 09:14 (quota errors from cloud provider) causing scheduling backlog. So it's multi-hit: auth rotation -> token churn -> proxy rate limits -> imagepull backoff -> pods pending -> autoscaler keeps spinning but no ready containers.
SupportBot: created ticket INC-2026-0421 and linked customer case ACME-9876.
Bryan Chen: repro steps I used:```
# reproduce locally (read-only)
kubectl -n acme get pods -o wide | egrep "Pending|ImagePullBackOff"
kubectl -n acme describe pod acme-service-7f6d8 | tail -n 40
# check proxy errors
curl -sS "https://imageproxy.internal/metrics" | grep dp-usw2a-23 -A3
```
Maya Patel: mitigation options for now: - ask acme to re-issue registry credentials and update imagePullSecret (fast) - bump minReplicas temporarily so warm pool remains available - pre-pull images on nodes (daemonset job) - request emergency increase for cloud node quota to let scheduler place pods faster.
Ellen Rios: I've contacted acme infra lead, they rotated token again and pushed new secret at 09:32. I also applied a temporary pre-pull daemonset:```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: prepull-acme
  namespace: acme
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: prepull
        image: busybox
        command: ["sh","-c","crictl pull acmeprod/service:2026-03-15 || true; sleep 3600"]
      tolerations: []
```
Bryan Chen: after pre-pull and new secret we saw ready pods start rolling in at 09:38 and req queue dropped under 20. Customer reports latency normalized ~09:45.
Kevin Zhao: follow-ups: 1) add autoscaler heuristic to detect sustained ImagePullBackOff spikes and mark capacity as ineffective (so it doesn't rely on just created nodes) 2) add a short-term burst allowance for imageproxy per dedicated pool or backoff jittering 3) document registry rotation best-practices for dedicated customers (pre-rotate secret + stagger).
Maya Patel: I'll open a backlog ticket for the heuristics and docs. Bryan, can you attach diagnostic logs to INC-2026-0421? Also request eng-oncall to review proxy rate-limits.
Bryan Chen: done — logs uploaded and customer updated. Marking as "investigating -> mitigated" for now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
SupportBot: INC-2026-0421 updated to status: mitigated (customer confirmed).
